Third-party code, copied in unchanged so the app needs no build step and no CDN.

- maplibre-gl 5.24.1 (BSD-3-Clause), from the npm package `maplibre-gl`, files `dist/maplibre-gl.js` and `dist/maplibre-gl.css`.
- satellite.js 7.2.0 (MIT), from the npm package `satellite.js`, the plain JavaScript files of `dist/` (without the optional WebAssembly build). Loaded as ES modules.
